name: Phase Encoding Polarity
description: Validates the phase encoding axis and polarity. Vendor-specific: Siemens encodes polarity in PhaseEncodingDirectionPositive, GE in RectilinearPhaseEncodeReordering; Philips does not encode polarity in DICOM (manual check).

testCases.name: Siemens COL with reversed polarity passes
Positive polarity fails when reversed is expected

parameterDefinitions.name: expected_axis
parameterDefinitions.label: Expected axis
parameterDefinitions.description: Required InPlanePhaseEncodingDirection (COL = A-P axis, ROW = R-L axis)

parameterDefinitions.name: expect_reversed
parameterDefinitions.label: Expect reversed polarity
parameterDefinitions.description: True for reversed polarity (e.g. P-A when the axis is COL), false for positive (e.g. A-P)
